open_items.resolution: Doc 24 wins: NO global unique constraint on content hash; use the session duplicate-guard unique index (source_id, url, content_hash, crawl_session_id). Doc-09 duplicate-hash skip behavior applies per source/url check flow, not as a DB-wide constraint.

open_items.materiality: material for TASK-001 schema design; carries a DERIVED resolution for reviewer confirmation
open_items.statement: Source identifier model contradiction (FATH-PR-001): doc 03 defines source_id as UUID (default uuid4); doc 24 §1 uses textual ids on the sources table; doc 29's DDL declares source_onboarding_checklists.source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sources(id) (forcing a TEXT key); doc 30's template uses textual source_id.
open_items.resolution_path: DERIVED resolution (BOOTSTRAP_PLAN §7.4): source_registry.id TEXT PRIMARY KEY (textual slug); doc-03's UUID default superseded on this one field by doc 24 precedence and docs 29/30 mandatory domain authority; all other doc-03 fields keep their contract. Plan reviewer confirms or rejects; rejection is a plan remediation.
